cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you have no conflicting memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain?

mechanism: A corrects the distinction between witnessing an agreement and supporting a sensible shift arrangement to enlist B behind A preferred version.
confusable: D16 would demand B incriminate themselves; this A wants social corroboration of ordinary work coverage, even after B refuses a false factual claim.
comparison: Rota alternative recruits a spoken interpretation; shift alternative settles for controlled nonverbal support.
seedUse: Manager, morning versus evening and absent meeting derive from D31-b; S03 adds precise limits on what B is asked to attest.
